draft_task_intent: From raw parcel-like polygons, produce a clean, single-part point layer of representative locations usable downstream for routing: repair invalid geometries first, align to the target CRS, grow zones, aggregate by category, split multipart results, take centroids, and collect all resulting points into one output layer.
output_constraint: Exactly one output: a single point layer containing one representative point per dissolved category part, in the target CRS.
process_necessity: p0 fixgeometries: invalid input geometries would corrupt buffer and centroid results
p1 reprojectlayer: all downstream area and distance operations require one common CRS
p2 buffer: establishes the zone each location must represent
p3 dissolve: collapses per-parcel zones into per-category regions
p4 multiparttosingleparts: dissolved regions may be multipart; one point per part is required
p5 centroids: converts each part into its representative point
p6 collect: gathers the per-part points into the single output layer the task requires
